IQVIA ONLINE ASSESSMENT (OA)

Company: IQVIA
Platform: SHL / Aspiring Minds (AMCAT Global)

==================================================
ASSESSMENT PATTERN
==================================================

Section 1: English Comprehension
22 Questions | 18 Minutes
Topics:
- Vocabulary
- Grammar
- Sentence Correction
- Para-Jumbles
- Reading Comprehension

Section 2: Logical Ability
14 Questions | 14 Minutes
Topics:
- Number/Letter Series
- Coding-Decoding
- Blood Relations
- Directions
- Anagrams
- Symbolic Inequalities
- Logical Sequence
- Data Sufficiency

Section 3: Quantitative Ability
14 Questions | 20 Minutes
Topics:
- Number Properties
- HCF & LCM
- Remainders
- Percentages
- Profit & Loss
- Pipes & Cisterns
- Age Problems

Section 4: Critical Reasoning
12 Questions | 15 Minutes
Topics:
- Logical Deduction
- Statement-Assumption
- Decision Making


==================================================
QUANTITATIVE ABILITY
==================================================

Q1. NUMBER LINE DISTANCE

4.28 and -3.28 are two numbers on a real number line.
If 1 is added to both numbers, which statement is true?

A. Distance increases by 2 units
B. Distance decreases by 2 units
C. Distance remains equal
D. None of the above

Answer: C


Q2. PERCENTAGE SCALING

If Anita scores 66 out of 100, how much does she score out of 75?

A. 50
B. 60
C. 66
D. 45

Answer: A (49.5, nearest option 50)


Q3. PIPES AND CISTERNS

Two pipes A and B can separately fill a cistern in
220 minutes and 330 minutes.

Together, they can fill the cistern in:

A. 1 hour 32 minutes
B. 1 hour
C. 2 hours 12 minutes
D. 2 hours
E. None

Answer: C


Q4. ODD NUMBERS

Product of two odd numbers is:

A. Always odd
B. Always even
C. Sometimes odd and sometimes even
D. Divisible by 6

Answer: A


Q5. MODULAR ARITHMETIC

When 2^35 is divided by 5, the remainder is:

A. 2
B. 3
C. 4
D. 0

Answer: B


Q6. HCF AND LCM

Product of two numbers is 9,152 and their HCF is 8.
What is their LCM?

A. 9,152
B. 1,1
